visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A man with medical bandages around his jaw lies in a hospital bed with blue pillows, looking slightly upwards and making an 'OK' hand gesture with his right hand. The lighting is bright and indoor. He then transitions to a close-up shot where he is smiling broadly and holding a red Colgate brand handheld mirror, revealing a straightened set of teeth. (2) The man is seen in a hospital setting wearing a light blue surgical gown and a green hair cap, laughing and moving his hands excitedly. The scene cuts to him lying down during a medical consultation where a hand reaches in to touch and examine his jawline. He appears calm yet reflective as the camera focuses on his facial features before and after surgery. (3) Dressed in casual clothes like an orange beanie and a striped sweater, the man sits at a table in a bright office-like environment, pointing at a 3D digital skull scan on a monitor while talking. He later appears in a pink hoodie, writing on documents, and then back in a clinical setting drinking from a specialized pink medical bottle with a tube, showing the practical aspects of post-surgery recovery. (4) The man is seen in a bookstore environment, holding a book with his own face on the cover titled '成全自己'. He smiles and laughs while showcasing the book to the camera. The video concludes with a wide shot of a group of about twenty people in an outdoor urban plaza, all holding the book and posing for a group photo, followed by a final shot of the man standing under a 'Lan Kwai Fong' street sign looking optimistic.

(3) During the transition to scenes in the bookstore and the group photo, the music volume swells slightly, and the tempo feels more upbeat. narrative_and_purpose.narrativeStructure: Linear: Hook -> Background -> Conflict/Challenge -> Resolution -> Promotion
narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The creator shares his personal 1.5-year journey of undergoing orthognathic surgery to correct dental and structural jaw issues. He aims to destigmatize the procedure as not just cosmetic but functional, and uses the narrative to promote his new book about his experiences.

endorsement_analysis.endorsementCues: The creator holds up his own book repeatedly, shows its placement in bookstores, and the final scene shows a group of fans/readers with the book.
